mara-venn.name: Mara Venn
knowledge: A lightning storm damaged the west telegraph span before her arrival.
Eli Rusk is the caretaker at Red Hollow.
The signal shed contains the relay equipment she has been sent to inspect.
does_not_know: Eli concealed a sealed railway dispatch satchel beneath the signal-shed floor.

eli-rusk.name: Eli Rusk
knowledge: A lightning storm damaged the west telegraph span.
A sealed railway dispatch satchel is hidden beneath the signal-shed floor.
Mara Venn does not know the satchel exists.
eli-rusk.intent: Keep the satchel concealed until a railway inspector can take custody.
